_comment: Coordinates are mean-Earth/polar-axis frame, east longitude 0-360. Region centres come from Mazarico et al. 2011 (Icarus 211, 1066) and Speyerer & Robinson 2013 (Icarus 222, 122); LROC fixes for the two CLPS landers. These regions are ~15 km wide, so where the DEM's illuminated point sits a few hundred metres from the published centre we take the illuminated point; 'source' records the origin of each coordinate. Last checked against the LOLA 80-90 S DEM by pipeline/validate_illumination.py.
